summary: Greenland Technologies Holding Corp. filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026, disclosing that Nasdaq determined the company regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The Class A ordinary shares (GTEC) closed at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days from September 8 through September 21, 2026. Nasdaq had granted a second 180-day period ending March 8, 2027, conditioned on a reverse split if needed. The deficiency matter is now closed; no deal terms, advisor, or structural mechanics are implicated.
